## Houston v0.6.3

- Community skills now open and install reliably, including popular marketplace skills.
- AI model setup is smoother with new Google Gemini keys and clearer guidance for Claude organization restrictions.
- Long Codex conversations recover more reliably when they need to make room for new messages.
- Updates are more dependable, with automatic updates on Linux and a clear notice when Houston cannot reach the update service.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
